name: Merchant's Ledger
desc: Your mother's ledger. Bankers trust your numbers.

name: Gunner's Eye
desc: Twelve years on Admiralty gun decks.

name: False Papers
desc: Customs men rarely look twice.

name: Storm Glass
desc: Its crystals cloud before every squall.

name: Lucky Compass
desc: Always points away from trouble. Mostly.

name: Sailor's Hex Doll
desc: Pirates feel strangely uninterested in you.

name: Brass Spyglass
desc: See the whites of their eyes.

name: Silver Tongue Charm
desc: Moneylenders find you oddly charming.

name: Golden Tankard
desc: Barkeeps pour faster and talk more.

name: Customs Blind Eye
desc: A bribe that never stops working.

name: Iron Ward Amulet
desc: Hulls hold together when they should not.

name: Seasoned First Mate
desc: Drills the gun crews hard.

name: Island Navigator
desc: Knows every squall-line by name.

name: Dockside Informant
desc: Always has a rumour ready.

name: Sharpshooter
desc: Picks off enemy gunners before they fire.

name: Reinforced Hull
desc: Oak doubling on the waterline.

name: Expanded Hold
desc: Clever carpentry below decks.

name: Swivel Carriages
desc: Guns reload faster.

name: Copper Sheathing
desc: Outrun what you cannot outgun.

name: Sealed Letter
desc: Wax seal of the Saltmere governor.

name: Grimmer's Chart
desc: Smudged lines lead to Blackwater Cay.

name: Rescued Cartographer
desc: Grateful, talkative and very good with charts.

name: Quartermaster
desc: Packs a hold like a puzzle box. More cargo fits in every ship.

name: Master Gunner
desc: Drills every gun crew in the fleet. Cannons reload faster.

name: Haggler's Tongue
desc: Every merchant in the Reach knows her. None of them like it.

name: Old Colours
desc: Raiders hesitate before firing on a ship they once sailed beside.

name: Crowe's Ledger
desc: Proof of Dimas Crowe's price-fixing. Merchants pay you a little more to keep quiet.

name: Undertow Signal Book
desc: Grimmer's flag signals. You know what his ships will do next.

name: Admiralty Warrant
desc: Signed by Lieutenant Hale. Customs officers wave you through more often.

name: Caked Powder Cask
desc: Salvage from the Resolute, branded with a hammer over a wave. It crumbles like wet sand.

name: Copied Ledger Page
desc: Quill's copy: six spoiled casks signed out to the Resolute by Captain S. Grimmer.

name: The Hammerhead's Manifest
desc: Every cask the Hammerhead carried, and who paid for it. You know raiders' powder when you see it.

name: Forged Customs Seal
desc: Struck from steel, with your mark, off a crate of raiders' muskets.

name: The Steel Die
desc: The die Lisle cut. You can tell any forged seal from a real one now, and so can the customs men you show it to.

name: Vega's Letter
desc: Marisol Vega's letter to Lieutenant Hale, sealed with the crest of a ruined house.

name: Logbook of the Lark
desc: Waterlogged, half the pages gone. Raiders give the ship that carries it a wide berth.

name: The Compact Ledgers
desc: Eleven years of copies in your own hand: water sold at three prices, cannon sold twice.

name: Spring Rights
desc: Fresh water outside the Compact. Ships pay you a little extra for a full cask.

name: Thorne's Orders
desc: A letter of marque against free traders, under Governor Thorne's seal. Privateers who read it lose their nerve.

name: Red Lantern
desc: Red glass and a hood to aim the beam. Kell's boats carried them. You read the coast better for having it.

name: House Vega Deeds
desc: The deeds to your family's warehouse, bought back from the creditors.

name: Grimmer's Letter
desc: An offer to restore House Vega, in a fine hand, if you stop. You kept it as evidence.

name: Raider Powder Sample
desc: Fine Admiralty-grade powder, scraped out of a raider's magazine.

name: Dorn's Schedule
desc: Where the Hammerhead anchors, month by month, in a frightened clerk's hand.

name: Quill's Affidavit
desc: Hester Quill's sworn statement on the Ironreef ledger, witnessed and sealed.

name: Brack's Receipts
desc: Payments from Crowe & Daughters to a raider captain, in Lisle's handwriting.

name: Pia Sorel's Statement
desc: What a survivor of the Lark saw from the water, signed before a magistrate.

name: The Salary List
desc: Which governors the Compact paid, how much, and on which day of the month.

name: Lanterna Chart, 1688
desc: The coast as it was the year the Morning Star went down, with the light's arc drawn in red.

name: Hollis Kell's Confession
desc: An old lamp-keeper's account of the night he let the light go out, and who paid him.
